name: rayucode
description: rayucode VSCode_Host — VS Code extension that surfaces the Rayu CLI agent. Depends on @rayucode/core (R13.2).

rayucode.cliPath.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the `rayu` executable. Leave empty to resolve it from the system `PATH`.

rayucode.includeActiveFile.description: Include the active file path in the prompt context sent to the agent.

rayucode.includeSelection.description: Include the active editor selection (and its file path) in the prompt context sent to the agent.

enumDescriptions: Prompt for approval based on each tool action's category.
Auto-approve file edits; still prompt for other sensitive actions.
Auto-approve every tool action without prompting.
Planning mode: the agent plans without executing tool actions.
Never prompt; deny any action that would otherwise require approval.
rayucode.permissionMode.description: Initial permission mode for a new session.

rayucode.diagnosticLogging.description: Write Control Protocol traffic and process lifecycle events to the rayucode log channel.

rayucode.unresponsiveTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of no protocol activity on a pending prompt before rayucode shows an unresponsive notice. Set to 0 to disable.

scripts.pretest:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run build
